title: Teacher's Session Plan: 90-Day Board Revision (Class 10 Science)
subject: Science

blocks.p: **For Kishan / teachers.** This assumes 3 sessions of about 1.5 hours a week. Each cell names the library file to use. If a batch has fewer sessions, merge S1 and S2 and keep S3 for testing. **Homework in Weeks 1–6:** after each chapter's session, hand out that chapter's daily practice pack (Day 1, Day 2, Day 3 on the next three days; answers in the notebook) and check notebooks at the start of the next session.

table: Ch 1: types of reactions, balancing (revision sheet + balancing worksheet)
Ch 2: indicators, pH, reactions, salts (revision sheet)
Ch 3: properties, reactivity series, extraction, corrosion
Ch 5: transport, excretion · Ch 6: nervous system, hormones
Ch 7: asexual and sexual reproduction, human reproduction
Ch 8: crosses with checkerboards · Ch 13: food chains, ozone, waste
Tests: Ch 7 + Ch 8 (Ch 13 test as homework)
Ch 9: mirrors: formula, sign convention, 6 ray diagrams
Ch 9: lenses, power · Ch 10: eye defects, dispersion, scattering
Ch 11: Ohm's law, series and parallel, numericals
Ch 11: heating, power, kWh · Ch 12: fields, rules, domestic circuits
Diagrams day (diagram checklist, each diagram drawn twice)
Numericals day (physics formula sheet + Set B numericals)
Set B re-tests: each student takes their 2 weakest chapters
Mock 1 (CBSE or GSEB pattern), 3 hours, exam conditions
Error-log clinic: re-teach the 3 most common mistakes
Drill: CBSE assertion–reason + case-based / GSEB 40 objective
Equation sheet: cover and write all 75 equations
Mock 3 discussion + one previous year's board paper as homework
Revision sheets Ch 1–4 + equation sheet quiz
Rapid Q&A on weak topics (no new material)
Exam strategy: time plan, presentation, reading time

blocks.h: After every test: same routine every time

bullets: Mark the papers within 2 days. Students should get their papers back while the test is still fresh.
Share marks with parents individually: send the marks list to Claude-as-me and it uses the **test-results** skill (class summary + one message per parent).
Start the next session with 10 minutes on the 2–3 most common mistakes.
Students copy their own mistakes into the error log at the back of the 90-day plan.

box: **Mock day tips.** Seat students as in the board exam. Give 15 minutes of reading time first. No phones in the room. Collect the papers at exactly 3 hours.
**Marking.** Use the marking scheme strictly, as an examiner would: half marks for missing units or labels. Students should feel the board standard before the boards.
